name: item-steps-up
comment: WP-2.1. A one-wide channel on the platform (stone walls at z = -1 and z = 1, x = -7..-1) with a flowing-water source (8) at (-7, 61, 0) and a one-high stone ledge at (-2, 61, 0). Item 0 at (-4.5, 61.125, 0.5) is pushed +x by the flow (World.handleMaterialAcceleration) against the ledge: an EntityItem has stepHeight 0, so moveEntity's step-up branch never runs and it stops (isCollidedHorizontally, motionX zeroed; Entity.java:382, :456-471). Item 1 slides at 0.3 towards +x into a lone stone block at (4, 61, -4). Sand (12) set at (4, 66, 4) above a half slab (44) at (4, 61, 4) falls as an EntityFallingSand, lands on the slab top (61.5) and, since canBlockBePlacedAt fails on the slab's cell, drops as an item (EntityFallingSand.java:58-66). entity_state every tick, rng_state every 10.
